tagline: Crafted Espresso & Community Warmth on Hoboken's Garden Street

storyBlock.headline: Crafted Espresso & Community Warmth on Garden Street
storyBlock.narrative: From velvety ube lattes to precision-poured swan latte art, Hey Coffee People is Hoboken's essential stop for uncompromised specialty coffee. Built on daily craft and genuine hospitality, every cup is poured to elevate your daily routine.

auditNotes: The official web domain heycoffeepeople.com currently displays an 'Under construction' holding page, turning away web traffic and searchers looking for hours or menus.
Lack of a functional mobile website forces potential customers to rely on fragmented third-party review pages rather than a direct digital storefront.

services.name: Signature Ube Latte
services.description: Vibrant house-made ube syrup paired with velvety steamed milk and espresso.

services.name: Artisan Pour Latte
services.description: Double-shot origin espresso finished with hand-poured swan or rosette latte art.

services.name: 18-Hour Draft Cold Brew
services.description: Slow-steeped micro-lot coffee with naturally sweet chocolate and subtle nutty notes.

services.name: Daily Artisan Pastry
services.description: Freshly baked flaky butter croissants and sweet treats sourced daily from neighborhood bakeries.
